race.description: Save Greyhound Racing In Tassie! Division1
race.comment: DAY RELEASE (3) has been racing well lately, making it two on end when saluting at this track last time over 340m in (19.59). Some good form is emerging from his last run. Well placed and can measure up. SHE'S TROUBLE (1) turned in a solid run last start over 340m at this track finishing 5th and beaten only 4 lengths (19.68). Can figure in the finish. ZIPPING EMILY (2) had been going along well winning a Restricted WIN three back then placing at Launceston before missing the frame latest when sixth (30.22) at Launceston. Well placed here and can atone this time. MISS SUE LEE (6) pinged the lids and wasn't headed last time. Must be respected.
